explanations.3: This tells apt (the package installer) to run in non-interactive mode so it won't pause asking for user input during the build.
explanations.8: After installing packages, we delete the cached package lists to make the final image smaller, since we won't need to reinstall them.
explanations.12: The printf command writes the XML data directly as a string into the file instead of using echo, which preserves the exact formatting without adding extra newlines.
explanations.18: This customizes the command prompt to show a whale emoji and color-coded text so you can visually confirm you're working inside a container, not your host machine.
explanations.20: This runs bash in interactive mode so when you start the container, you get a shell prompt ready for commands instead of the container immediately exiting.
